newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP says petroleum sell-off on owners' mind.
newsitem.headline: BHP says petroleum sell-off on owners' mind.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd's (BHP) petroleum chief executive John O'Connor on Monday said he expected shareholders were considering whether to sell the group's petroleum business.
O'Connor, responding to a question from a share analyst, told a briefing seminar that now was probably a good time to sell.
"There is a point when you hold and there is a point when you fold. That is a key strategic question," O'Connor said.
"I suspect that the representatives of the owners of BHP here today are probably pondering that problem," he said.
O'Connor told reporters later that he did not believe that a sale was being actively considered.
But he added: "If you ever thought of selling all or a part of it (petroleum division), now is the time to do it."
